description: Annual High Tide Flooding Outlook is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services (CO-OPS). Annual Outlooks show the number of high tide flooding days predicted for the coming meteorological year (May to April). The site also gives users a way to visualize observed and projected high tide flooding at National Ocean Service water level stations. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Critical Facilities, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – General. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
